name: vertical_microdrama
title: Vertical microdrama series
about: A series of 60-120 second vertical episodes, each ending on a cliffhanger.

prompt_rules.development_executive: Split the story into episodes of about 2 minutes; every episode needs a hook in the first 3 seconds and a cliffhanger at the end.
prompt_rules.screenwriter: Short scenes, strong conflict, a hook at the start of every episode.
prompt_rules.cinematographer: Vertical 9:16 framing: centred subjects, close-ups and medium shots, space for captions at the bottom.
prompt_rules.editor: Fast pacing; cut on action; end on the cliffhanger.
